post.caption: Atari's first winner melted the prize. In 1982, Atari launched Swordquest, a game series with real treasure. Each game came with a DC Comics booklet of clues. The first prize was an 18 karat gold talisman with 12 diamonds. The Franklin Mint made all the prizes. The grand prize was a jeweled sword with a gold handle. In May 1983, the first winner finished in just 46 minutes. He had the talisman melted down, keeping only a tiny sword. Then the 1983 video game crash hit Atari. The grand sword prize was never awarded. Only the chalice prize is known to survive.
